text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
In the Takarazuka Kinen, <chrname> conceded 1st 
place.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
However, a voice echoed out from a fan in 
the stands. "<chrname> will never give up on 
becoming the best in the world"... they 
said.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The fans believe in her. They don't see 
winning on the world stage as an 
impossible dream. They truly believe that 
she can make it happen.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Several days passed after that. At last, 
the Representative Exchange Race was about 
to begin. She heads toward the promised 
race to contend for representing Japan—
